verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official MCP server that connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading docs, and managing projects. It supports org/project scoping, a probe confirms the documented MCP page, and MCP access is listed even on the free tier. missing for 10: documented connection/auth setup details (transport, client configuration), independent hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
When scoped, tools automatically default to the constrained org/project and unnecessary discovery tools are hidden.
